name: 32-card Poker
description: 32-card Poker (French Poker) is draw poker using a 32-card stripped deck (7-A). 2-5 players. 5 cards each. Blinds, betting, draw up to 4, final betting, showdown. Key difference: Flush BEATS Full House (flushes are rarer). A can be low (A-7-8-9-10 straight valid). Suit ranking may break ties: ♥>♦>♣>♠.

content.text: 32-card Poker (French Poker) is draw poker using a 32-card stripped deck (7-A). 2-5 players. 5 cards each. Blinds, betting, draw up to 4, final betting, showdown. Key difference: Flush BEATS Full House (flushes are rarer). A can be low (A-7-8-9-10 straight valid). Suit ranking may break ties: ♥>♦>♣>♠.

32-card Poker is a draw poker variant that uses the traditional 32-card deck (seven through ace in each suit), the same pack used for Piquet and other European games. It is popular in Southern Europe and is sometimes called Stripped Deck Poker. The game adapts standard five-card draw to the shortened deck and alters hand rankings so that flushes rank above full houses, since flushes are rarer with fewer cards. The variant reflects regional preference for the piquet-style deck.
